pivHint: A CHIP is a tiny piece of silicon that powers a computer. It is also a thin, crunchy slice of potato, a salty ______.
winText: Crunch time. CHIP was the pivot - a computer part to a crunchy SNACK.
lossText: SNACK - a small bite between meals. CHIP was the pivot: a computer CHIP is a tiny circuit, but a potato CHIP is a crunchy SNACK.
